title: Review-convergence-v5: CredentialStore consolidation
notes:
Maintainer risk: LOW — The consolidation is correct and the precondition enforcement is solid. Three issues filed: (1) MalformedLine variant conflation is a future API evolution trap; (2) error message format divergence between reader and imap will confuse operators; (3) accidental re-export of looks_like_bcrypt_hash from reader::config adds unintended API surface. None of these are security or correctness issues.
Confidence: 5% chance of missed bug. Least confident flags: none — all three P1 issues are API surface and UX concerns, not correctness. Uncertainty driven by: cannot run integration tests against live newsreader clients; cannot verify that all startup paths through all three services (reader, imap, SMTP) call validate() before from_credentials(). The reader and imap paths are confirmed. SMTP path not checked. Would raise confidence if: SMTP startup path were checked for the same validate() guard.
Idiom rating: CLEAN — if/let Some(ref x) anti-pattern eliminated throughout, .to_owned() for literals, impl AsRef<Path>, Zeroizing<String> for password, #[non_exhaustive] on error enum, all correct. No clippy issues. No unsafe. No gratuitous clones.
Rust idiom confidence: 5% chance of missed issue. Least confident flags: none. Uncertainty driven by: SMTP crate startup path not reviewed to confirm validate() guard before from_credentials().
CORRECTION to confidence note: P0 bug found in SMTP crate. smtp::Config::validate() does not check auth.users bcrypt hashes. The from_credentials precondition doc says all startup paths call validate() first — not true for SMTP. Reader and IMAP have the check; SMTP was missed in these 5 commits. This is the most important finding.
VERDICT: NOT CONVERGED. One P0 bug found: smtp::Config::validate() does not check auth.users bcrypt hashes before CredentialStore::from_credentials() panics. Reader and IMAP have this check (added in this commit series); SMTP was missed. The precondition doc in from_credentials is therefore false for the SMTP startup path. Fix: add the looks_like_bcrypt_hash loop to smtp::Config::validate() and add a test, matching the imap pattern (use username in error message, not index). Three P1 issues are real but non-blocking for correctness: MalformedLine variant conflation, error message format inconsistency between services, and accidental re-export of looks_like_bcrypt_hash from reader::config.
